deleteAccountSection.removesYourDetailsFromRidearrivo: Removes your details from RideArrivo for good. This can't be undone.
deleteAccountSection.yourNameContactDetailsAny: Your name, contact details, any ID you uploaded, your saved emergency contacts and anything you wrote to support are removed, and you won't be able to sign in again.
deleteAccountSection.pastTripsStayOnFile: Past trips stay on file for 7 years because we're required to keep billing records: the date, the fare, and the pickup and destination addresses. The exact map coordinates, your rating comments and your emergency contact details are removed from those too.
deleteAccountSection.appleRevokeBody:
Your account is deleted. Apple still lists RideArrivo under your Apple ID, and only you can remove it.

On your iPhone: Settings, tap your name, then Sign in with Apple. Tap RideArrivo and choose Stop using Apple ID.

support.faqA0: Cancel more than 48 hours before pickup for a full refund. Inside 48 hours, you'll get a 50% refund.
support.faqA1: Card, wallet balance, or an active membership, all handled in the app at checkout. Fares are always confirmed before you pay.
support.faqA2: Yes. After a trip is marked completed, you can add a tip from your wallet or a card, right from that trip's screen.
support.faqQ3: Do I need to verify my ID?
support.faqA3: Verifying your ID (Profile → Verified ID) helps keep every trip safer for riders and drivers alike. You can still book before it's approved.
support.faqQ4: How does flight tracking work for airport pickups?
support.faqA4: Add your flight number when booking and we'll track it automatically, adjusting your pickup time for delays.
